registration.title: A level for each league, learned from matches between leagues
registration.what: Give every league a level shared by its clubs, moved by the results of matches between clubs of different leagues.
registration.why: League strength drifted for four seasons after every club started from a hand-set rank in 2020.
registration.how: A league-level step beside the club step in the rank replay, at seven strengths.
registration.hypothesis: Learning league levels directly corrects cross-league matches faster than club ranks alone.

expected.evidence: The final period had been looked at by earlier diagnostics, so this is strong historical evidence and not a blind test.

registration.success_criteria: The research round's bar (experiments/research_frame/REGISTER.md): better by 0.002 on the final period, the 99.6% interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing, better in 2024/25 and 2025/26, no goal market worse by 0.0005, and 60% of competitions no worse.

events.label: Best setting on the selection window
events.meaningful: No. Worse than production at every strength tried, so it was not scored on the final period.

events.reason: A league's cup and European results are its best few clubs' results and say little about the rest.
